editorial:
Imagine being a huge superstar with the whole world loving you, but inside your own head, everything is falling apart. You get to follow Sana Azim, a famous actress who struggles with schizophrenia and feels like people are constantly watching her. Then there is Aditya, the guy who truly loves her and tries his best to pull her back from the edge of madness. The vibe is very emotional and heavy, focusing more on the pain of mental illness than just a typical love story. It feels like a raw look at how loneliness can eat away at a person, even when they are surrounded by fame and flashing lights.

What really makes this work is the acting, as you can feel the frustration and sadness in every scene. While the story moves a bit slowly at times, the music is absolutely amazing and keeps you hooked. If you enjoy stories about complicated love and mental health, you should definitely give this a go.
endingExplained: In the end, Sana struggles deeply with her illness and the fear that people are out to get her. Aditya stays by her side, showing her that she is not alone. After a lot of pain and confusion, Sana finally finds some peace through love and medical help. The movie wraps up with a hopeful feeling, showing that while her struggle is hard, having someone who truly cares makes the journey possible.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves emotional dramas and stories about mental health.
